title: Roasted Middle Eastern Chickpea Toast
description: A flavorful and healthy snack combining roasted chickpeas with the rich taste of tahini in a smoky middle eastern twist.
instructions: 2. Rinse the chickpeas and place them on a baking sheet.
3. Drizzle with olive oil and season with salt.
4. Roast the chickpeas in the oven for 30 minutes, or until crispy.
5. Meanwhile, toast the pita bread slices in a toaster or under the broiler.
6. Spread a layer of tahini on each slice of toasted pita bread.
7. Top with roasted chickpeas, roasted red peppers, and a squeeze of lemon juice.
8. Garnish with chopped fresh parsley or cilantro, if desired.
